notes.title: A Thank You For Playing Our Little Dino Game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We wanted to say thanks to everyone who played our game. This is likely to be the final update for the game. We attempted to reduce the grind in the mid/late game to make unlocking the later dinos easier for you all after the feedback.

We're not satisfied with how this game turned out but we don't really have the time for further development of this game. This was mostly made to be a learning experience and we learned a lot from it. We're motivated to ensure higher quality for future projects.

We're truly sorry about the instability with save files even after we attempted multiple fixes, we realize how much of a bummer that is for you all as players. 

[b]Once again, we're really thankful to everyone who played and left us feedback, positive or negative.[/b]

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 21
notes.notes: - Made changes to the games saving system to try and help prevent save file loss

notes.title: 1.21 Hotix
notes.notes: -Fixed an issue that caused the load game feature to not work

notes.title: 1.2 Progress Loss Prevention Patch
notes.notes:
- Added an Autosave feature which runs every 5 minutes
- Greatly sped up saving speeds
- You can now resize the game window
- Fixed an issue with the rebirth multiplier not being applied correctly despite the multiplier showing the correct value
- Added UI to display the price of the next dino

We appreciate all your support and feedback so far!

notes.title: 1.1 Hotfix Changes
notes.notes:
We've heard your feedback and have released some important changes in this hotfix to allow the game to run in the background and to hopefully fix the rebirth bug where prices were not resetting.

Thank you for playing the game and giving us feedback!
